body:
## What this service is

**AirHelp Plus** (`https://www.airhelp.com/en-int/airhelp-plus/`) is an annual air-travel protection and claims-management membership suited to travelers flying through major European and international hubs (including Paris Charles de Gaulle CDG, Rome Fiumicino FCO, Barcelona BCN, Amsterdam AMS, Frankfurt FRA, and London Heathrow LHR). Unlike standard post-disruption claim agencies that deduct a contingency commission from statutory airline payouts, active AirHelp Plus members receive **100% of eligible airline compensation (up to €600) with no service fees deducted**, alongside fixed parametric-style insurance payouts and airport lounge access.

## Membership tiers and pricing

When verified on 29 October 2026, AirHelp Plus offered two annual plans on the web page (where one "trip" covers an entire outbound and return itinerary, including connecting flights):

- **Protect 3 Trips Plan:** Billed at **€39.99 per year** (€3.33/month equivalent).
- **Protect 9 Trips Plan (Most Popular):** Billed at **€99.99 per year** (€8.33/month equivalent).
- **Single Trip Protection:** Available exclusively through the free AirHelp mobile app for one-off bookings.

## Verified benefits and payout triggers

According to the page specifications and structured FAQ read on 29 October 2026, both annual plans include:

- **Flight Delay, Cancellation & Diversion Payout (€100):** Paid within days when a registered flight is delayed over **3 hours**, canceled at short notice, or diverted—paid on top of any statutory airline compensation.
- **Missed Connection Payout (€200):** Transferred within days when a disruption causes a missed connecting flight.
- **Lost or Delayed Luggage Payout (€100):** Rapid €100 insurance payout upon reporting lost or delayed bags, plus claims assistance for up to **€1,900** in airline baggage liability.
- **Airport Lounge Access (1,300+ lounges):** Complimentary lounge pass issued when your registered flight is delayed by **1+ hours** or canceled.
- **Free Fast Track Security:** Each registered trip receives a barcode pass for Fast Track security lanes at participating airports, even when flights run on time.
- **Zero-Fee Airline Compensation Claims (up to €600):** Full legal and administrative handling of EU Regulation 261/2004 and international passenger-rights claims with **no service fee**.

## Crucial 48-hour registration requirement

Per the official FAQ on the listing, you **must register your flight details at least 48 hours before your scheduled departure** for the insurance payouts, lounge access, and Fast Track security pass to apply.
